name: understand
title: Understand flow - engineer-grade project understanding and rules
description: Understand any project like an engineer: scan facts, map architecture, extract conventions, then generate project rules (AGENTS.md draft) and knowledge.json.

stages.title: Project scan (no AI)
done: context.md exists with git state, file tree, and manifest contents

stages.title: Architecture analysis
stages.prompt: Mode 2 (understand flow) for the project at {PROJECT}: produce the ARCHITECTURE part of .workbench/artifacts/understanding.md — purpose, modules and responsibilities, entry points, end-to-end request/data flow, external integrations, configuration surface. Ground everything in files you opened, with citations.
done: understanding.md contains an Architecture section with entry points and data flow backed by real paths

stages.title: Convention extraction
stages.prompt: Mode 2 (understand flow) for the project at {PROJECT}: extend .workbench/artifacts/understanding.md with a CONVENTIONS section — actual code style, naming, error handling, typing, test framework and layout, verified build/run/test commands, directory meaning. Verify commands against manifests (package.json etc.); on Windows note npm.cmd usage where relevant.
done: understanding.md contains a Conventions section with verified commands

stages.title: Rules & knowledge output
stages.prompt: From .workbench/artifacts/understanding.md for the project at {PROJECT}, produce: (1) .workbench/artifacts/agents-draft.md — a concise draft AGENTS.md for this project (working rules an AI agent needs: commands, conventions, gotchas, verification steps; keep it under 60 lines, no fluff); (2) .workbench/knowledge.json with the shape {"stack": [], "commands": {"install": "", "build": "", "test": "", "lint": "", "run": ""}, "conventions": [], "entryPoints": [], "gotchas": []} filled from verified findings only.
stages.gateQuestion: Write/update AGENTS.md in the project root from agents-draft.md?
done: agents-draft.md exists, concise and grounded in understanding.md
knowledge.json exists and parses as valid JSON with verified commands
stages.gateQuestionAr: أكتب/أحدّث AGENTS.md في جذر المشروع من المسودة agents-draft.md؟

titleAr: فلو الفهم — يفهم المشروع كمهندس ويولّد القواعد
